notes.title: February 25th Update - Version 0.16a
notes.content:
[h1]You Are Bugs 0.16a[/h1]

[h2][b]Added Features[/b][/h2]

[h3]Proximity Voice Chat[/h3]
You can now talk with other bugs you meet in the wild. Microphone input can be enabled/disabled any time. 

[h3]Spider Web Ability[/h3]
The spider can now shoot a web out of its butt. Useful for snagging those pesky flies out of the air, or getting to high places quickly. 

[h3]Bug Juice[/h3]
Flying and sprinting now require bug juice. Eat to get more bug juice. 

[h3]Camera Movement[/h3]
You can move the camera to look around, amazing. 

[h2][b]Changes[/b][/h2]

[list]
[*] Increased spider sonar range by 50%
[*] Changed sprint default behavior to toggle
[/list]

[h2][b]Fixes[/b][/h2]

[list]
[*] Fixed food exploit where prey could eat snail chunks indefinitely
[*] Fixed issue where you sometime float away after crawling over the edge of an object, or when dropped by fly
[*] Fixed snail explosion radius glitch
[*] Player name label removed on death
[*] Fixed missing colliders on rocks at bottom of circle thingy
[*] Fixed wing power UI showing up for non winged players.
[*] Fixed issue with headphones not playing when joining in progress
[*] Fixed issue where sitting in the ant hole as a spider when the gas starts does not allows spider to enter nest
[/list]
